findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step has no vessel and conflates the preheated block with reaction heating. Preserve block placement as an unmapped physical action; the following HeatChill step already represents the reaction at 80 °C.
The GC/MS completion check before solvent removal is omitted. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the permitted operations do not represent analytical monitoring.

findings.quote: chromatographic separation with silica gel (12% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
findings.message: The purification step records only generic chromatography. Preserve the silica-gel stationary phase and specified eluent composition explicitly outside the closed step fields.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Placement of the capped microreactor into the preheated block is not separately represented by an allowed operation. Reaction heating is represented by the 80 °C HeatChill step.
GC/MS was used to judge completion before THF removal; analytical monitoring is not represented by an allowed operation.
